column4: Define and implement the periodic H-Ledger reconciliation protocol against independent task, board/chat, git and artifact sources: cadence, frozen cutoff, source watermark, difference classes, explicit adjustment transaction format, and UNKNOWN/unavailable handling. Reuse existing accounting coverage; do not force equality or rewrite history. Receipt docs/task-receipts/coordination-hledger-reconcile-protocol-20260909.md.

Evaluate whether an explicitly synthetic effort/weight commodity answers a real coordination question beyond unit counts. Keep it separate from USD/cash, outcome quality and routing; document invariants, attribution coverage, adjustment semantics and a negative case where the commodity must not be used. Receipt docs/task-receipts/coordination-hledger-synthetic-effort-20260909.md.

Build and verify a read-only H-Ledger report by mind showing task volume, effort, age, rework/reopen, completion, outcome evidence and unattributed/unknown coverage as separate axes. Compare the report with the existing plan and identify load-balancing signals without equating volume with quality. Receipt docs/task-receipts/coordination-hledger-mind-load-20260909.md.

Independently accept the extension: replay a missing source, delayed feed, balanced-but-incomplete feed and explicit adjustment; verify cadence wiring and evidence age; confirm task liabilities and routing remain unchanged. Publish PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN and unresolved obligations. Receipt docs/task-receipts/coordination-hledger-reconciliation-acceptance-20260909.md.
